description: Shared LLM and decoding configuration that produced the 144 archived runs (72 per log, two OCEL 2.0 logs) in results/runs/ (BPI 2017) and results/order_management/runs/. Per-run traces themselves do not include these fields; the manifest documents them centrally for reproducibility.

datasets.dataset_label: BPI Challenge 2017 (Loan Application), converted to OCEL 2.0

notes: These parameters were frozen before execution; see thesis Method §3.7 (Implementation Protocol).
The .env.example defaults are illustrative for new installations and may differ; set LLM_MODEL=gpt-5.5 and TASK_TIMEOUT_S=600 to reproduce the thesis runs.

Both per-log task sets (BPI 2017 tasks A1-C4 and Order Management tasks OM-A1-OM-C4) are specified in the thesis Method chapter; Category-A ground truth for both logs was cross-checked by raw SQL and the project tools (SQL == tool).
